title: SEC3: DEFAULT_BASE_URL doc omits deprecated KITH_BASE_URL fallback
description: The doc comment on DEFAULT_BASE_URL (crates/kithd/src/lib.rs lines 32-37) says 'read from KITHD_BASE_URL (default: https://kith.local)' but session_handler also checks the deprecated KITH_BASE_URL before falling back to the constant. A reader of the doc alone does not know the deprecated fallback exists. The doc should mention all three resolution steps or explicitly cross-reference the cascade. The three-branch if-let itself is idiomatic Rust for this cascading pattern; no cleaner stdlib alternative exists without a helper function.
